doc_friction.issue: Step 0's open list held 4 entries that all already have owner-gated control-plane PRs (#12928, #12926, #14612, #14698); redteam.py open could show the open PR per entry so runs stop re-checking them.

run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes needs `git fetch --depth=40 origin main` first in a fresh clone (it says so), and the full run exceeds the 10-min foreground limit: start it with run_in_background from the outset.

--for-changes gives each workflow a 300 s budget, so portfolio-pages' site-builder step (~5 min here) always reads TIMEOUT and every later step FAIL; the summary looks red for reasons unrelated to the diff. Running `node --test` in platform/pages directly found the real failure.

notes: Target ventures/concrete-maturity/maturity.mjs (new on main 2026-11-10). 3 campaigns x 8 mutants: 12/24 caught. 9 gaps guarded, 3 equivalent (checked by an 80-set comparison script for the two optimiser mutants). Catch rate 0.571 -> 1.0 of non-equivalent. 4 real defects found and patched with failing tests first (thousands comma in calibration, rolled-over timestamps, 'Average' as time column, elapsed_min read as hours). Guard added (4b-style): a test pinning every number maturity-method-explained.html quotes for the worked example, so a page/code drift fails CI. Local: node --test in ventures/concrete-maturity 32/32 pass; defect tests fail (4) against the pre-fix maturity.mjs. Class not generalised: other ventures' CSV header regexes may share the \b/underscore and substring issue; headerHasWord is local to this venture. Also fixed a pre-existing faq-visible failure on concrete-maturity/index.html (see errors).

real_defects.issue: parseCalibrationText split '7, 3,420' and '7 3,420' on the thousands comma, reading the strength as 3 psi with no error. Fixed: with a space/tab/semicolon between fields, a d,ddd number keeps its comma as a thousands separator.

parseTimestamp let Date.UTC roll impossible cells over ('2/30/2026 25:00' became 3 March 01:00; 13:00 PM, minute 75, 31-Apr accepted). Fixed: utcChecked validates month, day of month, hour, minute, second and the 1-12 AM/PM hour.

With no timestamp column, the time-column regex matched 'age' inside 'Average'/'Stage' (and 'min' inside 'Minimum'), so 'Average (°C),Elapsed (h)' read the temperatures as hours and the hours as degrees. Fixed: headerHasWord requires a non-letter on each side.
elapsedScale used \b, which an underscore defeats, so 'elapsed_min' and 'time_s' were read as hours (60x / 3600x the maturity, overestimating strength). Fixed with the same headerHasWord.
